2609.19387.title: Do AI Agents Understand Computer Architecture?
2609.19387.paper_summary: Agents are increasingly asked to design hardware, and increasingly reported to succeed. Such reports establish that a design improved; they cannot establish why. An agent that improves an accelerator may be reasoning about the machine, or may be searching competently over knobs whose meaning it never recovers -- and only the first transfers to the next architecture. Existing evaluations cannot tell the two apart, because they vary the agent while holding the framing of the problem fixed. We do the opposite. AutoTuring hands the same agent the same 15-dimensional accelerator space twice: once as named architectural knobs with simulator counters, once as anonymous variables on [0,1], with the evaluator, the legal space and the reachable optima held identical, so that the only thing that varies is whether the problem means anything. The gap between the two is the measurement. On a nine-kernel FP16 GEMM basket, meaning pays: the architect beats a modeled H200 by 5.4% and its blind counterpart by 12.3% on average, with 70.1% fewer simulator calls. It does not pay uniquely: a critic loop recovers most of that gap for the blind agent and buys the architect nothing, so architectural knowledge and structured critique behave as substitutes rather than as complements. We report these as preliminary findings -- five to six runs per condition on a single modeled accelerator -- and take the comparison itself, not the accelerator, to be the contribution.
2609.19387.paper_summary_zh: 代理人越來越被要求設計硬體，且越來越多報告顯示其成功。這些報告證明了一個設計有所改進；但無法確定其原因。改善加速器的代理人可能是在推理機器，或者可能是在對其意義從未恢復的旋鈕進行有效搜索——而只有前者能轉移到下一個架構。現有的評估無法區分這兩者，因為它們在固定問題框架的情況下變動代理人。我們則做了相反的事情。AutoTuring 讓同一代理人兩次面對相同的 15 維加速器空間：一次是以命名的架構旋鈕和模擬器計數器，另一次是以 [0,1] 上的匿名變數，評估者、合法空間和可達最優解保持不變，因此唯一變化的是問題是否有意義。這兩者之間的差距就是測量。在一個九核 FP16 GEMM 範疇中，意義是有價值的：架構師平均比模擬的 H200 高出 5.4%，比其盲目對手高出 12.3%，且模擬器調用減少了 70.1%。這並不是唯一的收益：批評循環為盲目代理人彌補了大部分差距，並未給架構師帶來任何收益，因此架構知識和結構性批評的作用是替代而非互補。我們將這些報告視為初步發現——每個條件進行五到六次運行，針對單一模擬加速器——並認為比較本身，而非加速器，才是貢獻所在。
